system.description: You can bestow a panoply of delusions and dementia upon your victim, with no control over the form the madness takes. You must hold your victim's total attention for an entire turn, then expend a Blood Trait and enter a Social Challenge with your victim. If you win, the victim gains five derangements, chosen by the Storyteller. They start out subtly but quickly build and remain in full force for the rest of the evening. Howling Lunacy may not be repeated on the same victim in the same evening to grant additional derangements.
